# FSG Electric & Lighting

> > FSG (Facility Solutions Group) provides commercial electrical construction, LED lighting retrofits, sign installation, and energy-efficient solutions across multiple U.S. markets including San Antonio, Austin, Denver, San Francisco, and New Jersey.

FSG serves commercial, healthcare, education, and infrastructure clients with comprehensive electrical systems, lighting design and maintenance, channel letter signage, and smart building technologies. The company operates through multiple regional offices delivering turnkey electrical and lighting solutions for retail chains, hospitals, colleges, and mixed-use developments.

## Core Services

- [Lighting Maintenance | Proactive Maintenance Plans | FSG](https://fsg.com/lighting/lighting-maintenance): Proactive lighting maintenance plans reducing outages and costs
- [Sign Installation | FSG Signs](https://fsg.com/signs/installation): Professional sign installation services for commercial projects
- [Channel Letter Signage - FSG Signs](https://fsg.com/signs/channel-letter-signs): Custom channel letter signage with LED lighting for brand visibility
